label: Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011
authority: Department of Consumer Affairs — Legal Metrology Division
source_note: Clause citations, the Rule 7(2) Table-I font-height values and the MRP 'inclusive of all taxes' wording are taken verbatim from the 2011 Rules as amended (notably G.S.R. 629(E), 23.6.2017). Regexes are engineered detectors for those provisions. Verify against the current gazette (indiacode.nic.in, consumeraffairs.nic.in) before a live deployment.

declarations.label: Name & address of manufacturer / packer / importer

checks.message: Name & address of the manufacturer/packer/importer is missing.
Address appears incomplete — a full postal address is required.

declarations.label: Common or generic name of the commodity

checks.message: Common/generic name of the commodity is missing.
Net quantity declaration is missing.
Net quantity must use a standard metric unit (g, kg, ml, l, m) or a count.
Net quantity must appear on the principal display panel.
Net quantity numerals are smaller than the minimum height required for this package size (Rule 7(2), Table-I).

declarations.label: Month & year of manufacture / packing / import

checks.message: Month & year of manufacture/packing is missing.
Manufacture/packing/import date label not found.
Manufacture/packing date is invalid or lies in the future.

declarations.label: Best before / use by date
declarations.note: Required for commodities that may become unfit for human consumption. By the proviso to Rule 6(1)(da), this clause defers where another law provides for it — e.g. for food articles the FSS date-marking regime governs (enforced critically by the FSSAI pack). Kept advisory here so it is validated when printed without double-penalising food.

checks.message: Best before / use by date is not declared.
Best-before / use-by label not found.
Best-before / use-by date is invalid or does not follow the manufacture date.
MRP is missing.
MRP label not found.
MRP must be declared as inclusive of all taxes (e.g., 'Maximum Retail Price ₹__ inclusive of all taxes').
MRP value is missing or is not a valid positive amount.
MRP must appear on the principal display panel.
Consumer care details are missing.
Consumer care contact label not found.
Consumer care must include a contact phone number or email.
Country of origin is required for imported packages.
Country of origin label not found.

declarations.label: Unit sale price
declarations.legal_reference: Advisory — not a distinct clause of LMPC 2011

checks.message: Unit sale price (per g / ml / piece) is not declared.
Dimensions are not declared (required where relevant to the commodity).

font_height_table.note: Verbatim Rule 7 Table-I, normal-printing column, for net quantity declared by weight or volume. Where numerals are blown/formed/moulded/embossed the minima are higher (1.5 / 3.0 / 4.0 / 6.0 / 6.0 mm); we enforce the stricter normal-print values. For net quantity by length/area/number, Table-II applies instead.

scoring.verdict_rule: any failed CRITICAL check => non_compliant; else any failed MAJOR => needs_review; else compliant
scoring.score_formula: 100 * sum(weight of passed checks) / sum(weight of all applicable checks)
